items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: I learned that from working with Dorsey

ctx.x: Oh okay, I asked him one time, I said — because I saw him one night and we were playing and he sat in with Basie’s band and he knew all the charts — “Whirly Bird” he knew everything. And he came out, I said, “Buddy, how did you do that without” — because he doesn’t read music. He said, “Well I know all the charts of every book,” he said, “Tommy Dorsey,” he said, “I have them all in my head.” I said, “What happens if somebody throws you a chart you don’t know?” He said, “You see why I’m always looking to the…

One Suite” goes [counts quickly], so it had that kind of, you know that fake three and five, which is really eight. But you know that’s the way it was broken up. He listened to it for just a little bit and then he went, “Get off the drums” and he went up and played the part.
